word: Title: Morning At The Small Market
answer: Mañana En El Mercado Pequeño

word: I arrive early to a good morning.
answer: Llego temprano a una mañana buena.

word: The bad weather from yesterday is gone.
answer: El clima malo de ayer ya se fue.

word: The big market opens slowly around me.
answer: El mercado grande se abre lentamente a mi alrededor.

word: I am going to buy small fruit first.
answer: Voy a comprar fruta pequeña primero.

word: The long line forms as more people arrive.
answer: La fila larga se forma mientras llega más gente.

word: The short wait feels calm with soft music.
answer: La espera corta se siente tranquila con música suave.

word: A tall vendor greets me with a smile.
answer: Un vendedor alto me saluda con una sonrisa.

word: We are going to sit at a low table soon.
answer: Vamos a sentarnos en una mesa baja pronto.

word: A new stand displays bright vegetables today.
answer: Un puesto nuevo muestra verduras brillantes hoy.

word: An old basket hangs beside the counter.
answer: Una canasta vieja cuelga junto al mostrador.

word: A young cashier organizes the fresh bills.
answer: Una cajera joven acomoda los billetes frescos.

word: They are going to try the first salsa now.
answer: Van a probar la primera salsa ahora.

word: The last basket holds warm tortillas inside.
answer: La última canasta tiene tortillas calientitas adentro.

word: We return to the same friendly vendor again.
answer: Regresamos al mismo vendedor amable otra vez.

word: You pick another snack to share later [sing, inf].
answer: Eliges otro antojito para compartir después.

word: The only table free waits near the window.
answer: La única mesa libre espera cerca de la ventana.

word: We finish the entire plate without rushing.
answer: Terminamos el plato entero sin prisa.

word: The flavors taste different but very comforting.
answer: Los sabores saben diferentes pero muy reconfortantes.

word: They are going to buy several drinks next.
answer: Van a comprar varias bebidas después.

word: I am going to take few bags for home.
answer: Voy a llevar pocas bolsas para la casa.
